features.name: version_major
features.description: Major version number parsed via PEP 440 from release metadata.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: version_minor
features.description: Minor version number parsed via PEP 440 from release metadata.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: version_patch
features.description: Patch/micro version number parsed via PEP 440 from release metadata.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: is_prerelease
features.description: 1 if release version is marked as pre-release (alpha/beta/rc/dev), 0 otherwise.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: has_requires_python
features.description: 1 if release specifies requires_python environment constraint, 0 otherwise.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: requires_python_len
features.description: Character length of requires_python constraint string.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (intrinsic release metadata).

features.name: declared_dependency_count
features.description: Number of declared dependencies in requires_dist for this specific release.
features.temporal_provenance: Available at upload timestamp t (release-specific dependency declaration).

features.name: hist_release_count_before_t
features.description: Number of releases of this package uploaded strictly prior to timestamp t.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from historical releases where release_timestamp < t.

features.name: hist_age_days_at_t
features.description: Days elapsed since the package's earliest historical release prior to t.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from historical releases where release_timestamp < t.

features.name: time_since_prev_release_days
features.description: Days elapsed since the package's immediate preceding release uploaded prior to t.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from historical releases where release_timestamp < t.

features.name: hist_release_frequency
features.description: Historical release cadence (releases/year) as of timestamp t.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from historical releases where release_timestamp < t.

features.name: dynamic_downstream_in_degree
features.description: Number of distinct external releases uploaded prior to t declaring a dependency on this package.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from dependency edges where edge_time < t.

features.name: hist_advisories_count_before_t
features.description: Count of distinct public OSV advisories published strictly prior to t affecting prior releases.
features.temporal_provenance: Computed strictly from OSV records where published_timestamp < t and affected_version != target_version.
